facts.fact: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications states the ministry's sector reports progress against the government action plan carrying the President's digitalisation commitments (interview published 2023-11-15, no other date given).
facts.system: Plan d'action du secteur de la Poste et des Télécommunications (feuille de route to end-2024)

facts.fact: The minister says progress is measured against the sector action plan for the President's commitments, with targets set for end-2024 (interview published 2023-11-15, which is the date used).
facts.system: Plan d'action du secteur de la Poste et des Télécommunications (feuille de route to end-2024)

facts.fact: The minister says intermediate objectives were met and the sector expects to reach the objectives set for end-2024 (interview published 2023-11-15).
facts.system: Plan d'action du secteur de la Poste et des Télécommunications (feuille de route to end-2024)

facts.fact: The action plan carries dated targets with no cost stated: fixed-internet homes from 3.5 to 6 million, general FTTH rollout, higher minimum speed and international bandwidth, by end-2024.
facts.system: Plan d'action du secteur de la Poste et des Télécommunications (feuille de route to end-2024)

facts.fact: The minister reports against the plan's targets in an interview: 5.4 million fixed-internet homes against 6 million, FTTH from about 53,000 to over 1 million homes, minimum speed x5, international bandwidth x6, e-payment cards from 6 to over 12 million; ministry's own claims, not a published report.
